attempts.summary: Implemented an Ansible-driven port forward: node2's demo HTTP app (port 8080) runs on a dedicated private-network NIC shared with node1 (a VyOS router), and node1 publishes that app to node3 via DNAT + SNAT(masquerade), gated by a default-drop VyOS forward firewall that only permits the specific published flow plus established/related traffic. Verified from node3 that the published port works while the rest of the private network (10.50.50.0/24) stays unreachable, both immediately after deployment and after a full one-at-a-time restart of all four managed nodes.
